instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security

questions.question: Why has the traditional network perimeter eroded?
options: Because of cloud, distributed work and IoT growth.
Because firewalls became too expensive to licence.
Because encryption made packets unreadable.
Because routing protocols stopped converging.
options_ar: بسبب السحابة والعمل الموزّع ونمو إنترنت الأشياء.
لأن التشفير خلّى الحزم غير مقروءة.
لأن بروتوكولات التوجيه توقّفت عن التقارب.
options_en: Because of cloud, distributed work and IoT growth.
Because firewalls became too expensive to licence.
Because encryption made packets unreadable.
Because routing protocols stopped converging.
questions.explanation: Cloud adoption, distributed workforces and the proliferation of IoT devices all blur the line between inside and outside.
questions.explanation_ar: تبنّي السحابة والقوى العاملة الموزّعة وانتشار أجهزة إنترنت الأشياء كلها تموّه الخط بين الداخل والخارج.

questions.question: What is network segmentation?
options: Copying the network into a second datacentre.
Dividing a network into isolated segments with access controls.
Encrypting every segment with a separate symmetric key.
Replacing all routers with layer-two switches.
options_ar: نسخ الشبكة إلى مركز بيانات ثانٍ.
تقسيم الشبكة إلى قطاعات معزولة بضوابط وصول.
تشفير كل قطاع بمفتاح متماثل منفصل.
استبدال كل الموجّهات بمبدّلات طبقة ثانية.
options_en: Copying the network into a second datacentre.
Dividing a network into isolated segments with access controls.
Encrypting every segment with a separate symmetric key.
Replacing all routers with layer-two switches.
questions.explanation: It is the practice of dividing a network into multiple segments, each isolated by access controls or firewalls.
questions.explanation_ar: هي ممارسة تقسيم الشبكة إلى عدة قطاعات، كل واحد معزول بضوابط وصول أو جدارات نارية.

questions.question: Which three objectives does segmentation pursue?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاثة أهداف يسعى لها التقسيم؟
options: Backup, replication and disaster recovery.
Authentication, authorization and accounting.
Breach containment, performance and policy enforcement.
Encryption, compression and deduplication.
options_ar: النسخ الاحتياطي والتكرار والتعافي من الكوارث.
options_en: Backup, replication and disaster recovery.
Authentication, authorization and accounting.
Breach containment, performance and policy enforcement.
Encryption, compression and deduplication.
questions.explanation: It contains breaches, reduces congestion by limiting broadcast traffic, and applies granular controls to sensitive flows.
questions.explanation_ar: يحتوي الاختراقات، ويقلّل الازدحام بالحدّ من حركة البثّ، ويطبّق ضوابط دقيقة على التدفقات الحسّاسة.

questions.question: What does breach containment mean in practice?
options: The attacker is deleted from the network immediately.
The breach is reported to the regulator within a day.
The compromised zone is rebuilt from backup.
An attacker in one zone cannot reach the others.
options_ar: الاختراق يُبلَّغ للجهة التنظيمية خلال يوم.
المنطقة المخترقة تُعاد من نسخة احتياطية.
المهاجم داخل منطقة ما يقدر يوصل الباقي.
options_en: The attacker is deleted from the network immediately.
The breach is reported to the regulator within a day.
The compromised zone is rebuilt from backup.
An attacker in one zone cannot reach the others.
questions.explanation: Containment is about limiting blast radius, not about removing the attacker, which is a separate response problem.
questions.explanation_ar: الاحتواء يتعلّق بتحديد نصف قطر الانفجار، مو بإزالة المهاجم، فهذا مشكل استجابة منفصل.

questions.question: How does segmentation improve performance?
options: By limiting broadcast traffic within each segment.
By encrypting less traffic on the backbone.
By compressing every packet before routing.
By adding more routing hops between zones.
options_ar: بالحدّ من حركة البثّ داخل كل قطاع.
بتشفير ترافيك أقل على العمود الفقري.
بإضافة قفزات توجيه أكثر بين المناطق.
options_en: By limiting broadcast traffic within each segment.
By encrypting less traffic on the backbone.
By compressing every packet before routing.
By adding more routing hops between zones.
questions.explanation: Broadcast domains stay small, so a segment is not disturbed by traffic that has no business reaching it.
questions.explanation_ar: نطاقات البثّ تبقى صغيرة، فالقطاع ما ينزعج بترافيك ما له علاقة بيه.

questions.question: What does the policy enforcement objective add to segmentation?
questions.question_ar: شنو يضيف هدف فرض السياسات على التقسيم؟
options: A guarantee that no zone can ever be breached.
Granular controls on sensitive or regulated flows.
A single flat policy applied to the whole network.
Automatic discovery of every asset in the network.
options_ar: ضمان إن أي منطقة ما تنخترق أبداً.
ضوابط دقيقة على التدفقات الحسّاسة أو المنظَّمة.
سياسة واحدة مسطّحة على كل الشبكة.
options_en: A guarantee that no zone can ever be breached.
Granular controls on sensitive or regulated flows.
A single flat policy applied to the whole network.
Automatic discovery of every asset in the network.
questions.explanation: Segmentation is the precondition for differential policy: you can only treat a flow specially if you can identify where it is going.
questions.explanation_ar: التقسيم شرط مسبق للسياسة التفاضلية: ما تقدر تعامل تدفقاً معاملة خاصة إلا إذا تعرف وين رايح.

questions.question: How can segmentation be implemented?
options: Only logically, since hardware cannot be separated.
Through encryption keys rather than topology.
Logically through VLANs or SDN, or physically.
Only physically, with separate hardware networks.
options_ar: منطقياً فقط، لأن العتاد ما ينفصل.
منطقياً عبر VLANs أو SDN، أو فيزيائياً.
options_en: Only logically, since hardware cannot be separated.
Through encryption keys rather than topology.
Logically through VLANs or SDN, or physically.
Only physically, with separate hardware networks.
questions.explanation: Logical separation lives in configuration, physical separation lives in cabling, and the choice depends on the threat model and budget.
questions.explanation_ar: الفصل المنطقي بالإعداد، والفصل الفيزيائي بالكابلات، والاختيار يعتمد على نموذج التهديد والميزانية.

questions.question: What does VLAN-based segmentation isolate?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعزله التقسيم القائم على VLAN؟
options: IP address ranges between routers.
Application processes inside the host.
Encryption keys between the zones.
Broadcast domains inside the switches.
options_en: IP address ranges between routers.
Application processes inside the host.
Encryption keys between the zones.
Broadcast domains inside the switches.
questions.explanation: It is logical separation within the switch, which is why it is cheap but tied to layer-two topology.
questions.explanation_ar: هو فصل منطقي داخل المبدّل، ولهذا رخيص لكن مربوط بطوبولوجيا طبقة الربط.

questions.question: What does subnetting control?
questions.question_ar: شنو يتحكّم به التقسيم إلى شبكات فرعية؟
options: Communication between address ranges via routing policy.
Broadcast domains without any routing involved.
The encryption of flows between applications.
The identity of the users on each segment.
options_ar: الاتصال بين نطاقات العناوين عبر سياسة التوجيه.
options_en: Communication between address ranges via routing policy.
Broadcast domains without any routing involved.
The encryption of flows between applications.
The identity of the users on each segment.
questions.explanation: It splits address ranges into smaller segments and controls the resulting traffic through routing policies.
questions.explanation_ar: يقسّم نطاقات العناوين إلى قطع أصغر ويتحكّم بالترافيك الناتج عبر سياسات التوجيه.

questions.question: What characterises firewall segmentation?
options: Automatic discovery of network assets.
Rules that limit access between the segments.
Physical separation of the cabling plant.
Per-process isolation inside one host.
options_ar: قواعد تحدّ من الوصول بين القطاعات.
عزل لكل عملية داخل مضيف واحد.
options_en: Automatic discovery of network assets.
Rules that limit access between the segments.
Physical separation of the cabling plant.
Per-process isolation inside one host.
questions.explanation: Here the segment boundary is expressed as policy on a device, which makes it flexible but dependent on rule quality.
questions.explanation_ar: هنا حدّ القطاع يُعبَّر عنه كسياسة على جهاز، وهذا يخليه مرناً لكن معتمداً على جودة القواعد.

questions.question: At what level does micro segmentation operate?
options: At the autonomous system level.
At the certificate authority level.
At the workload or application level.
At the broadcast domain level only.
options_en: At the autonomous system level.
At the certificate authority level.
At the workload or application level.
At the broadcast domain level only.
questions.explanation: It isolates individual workloads and applications, often enforced through software-defined networking.
questions.explanation_ar: يعزل أحمال العمل والتطبيقات فرادى، وغالباً يُفرض عبر الشبكات المعرّفة برمجياً.

questions.question: What distinguishes micro segmentation from VLAN-based segmentation?
questions.question_ar: شنو يميّز التقسيم الدقيق عن التقسيم القائم على VLAN؟
options: Micro separates broadcast domains, VLAN separates workloads.
Micro works only on physical hardware, VLAN only virtual.
Micro requires no policy at all, VLAN requires routing.
Micro uses identity policy per workload, VLAN per broadcast domain.
options_ar: الدقيق يفصل نطاقات البثّ، والـ VLAN يفصل الأحمال.
الدقيق على العتاد الفيزيائي فقط، والـ VLAN افتراضي فقط.
الدقيق بلا أي سياسة، والـ VLAN يحتاج توجيهاً.
الدقيق سياسة هوية لكل حِمل، والـ VLAN لكل نطاق بثّ.
options_en: Micro separates broadcast domains, VLAN separates workloads.
Micro works only on physical hardware, VLAN only virtual.
Micro requires no policy at all, VLAN requires routing.
Micro uses identity policy per workload, VLAN per broadcast domain.
questions.explanation: Both isolate, but at different granularity: one draws a line around a switch domain, the other around a single workload's conversations.
questions.explanation_ar: الاثنان يعزلان، لكن بحبيبية مختلفة: واحد يرسم خطاً حول نطاق مبدّل، والثاني حول محادثات حِمل واحد.

questions.question: Why are flat networks dangerous?
options: They let an attacker move from low to high value.
They cannot carry broadcast traffic at all.
They require more routers than segmented ones.
They encrypt traffic too aggressively by default.
options_ar: تسمح للمهاجم بالحركة من منخفض القيمة لعاليه.
ما تقدر تحمل حركة بثّ أبداً.
options_en: They let an attacker move from low to high value.
They cannot carry broadcast traffic at all.
They require more routers than segmented ones.
They encrypt traffic too aggressively by default.
questions.explanation: Without internal boundaries, one compromised workstation is effectively adjacent to every server in the estate.
questions.explanation_ar: بلا حدود داخلية، محطة عمل مخترقة واحدة تصير مجاورة فعلياً لكل سيرفر بالمؤسسة.

questions.question: In the formal model, what do the vertices and edges of the network graph represent?
questions.question_ar: بالنموذج الشكلي، شنو تمثّل عقد المخطّط وحوافه؟
options: Nodes are policies and edges are rules.
Nodes are devices, edges are communication links.
Nodes are packets and edges are time intervals.
Nodes are users and edges are credentials.
options_en: Nodes are policies and edges are rules.
Nodes are devices, edges are communication links.
Nodes are packets and edges are time intervals.
Nodes are users and edges are credentials.
questions.explanation: Reducing the network to a graph is what lets reachability be counted rather than argued about.
questions.explanation_ar: اختزال الشبكة إلى مخطّط هو اللي يخلي الوصول يُعدّ بدل ما يُجادل فيه.

questions.question: How is the probability of reaching the target expressed without segmentation?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن احتمال الوصول للهدف بدون تقسيم؟
options: The number of vertices over the number of attack paths.
The product of paths and edges in the graph.
The number of possible attack paths over the number of edges.
The number of edges over the number of possible attack paths.
options_ar: عدد العقد على عدد مسارات الهجوم.
عدد مسارات الهجوم الممكنة على عدد الحواف.
عدد الحواف على عدد مسارات الهجوم الممكنة.
options_en: The number of vertices over the number of attack paths.
The product of paths and edges in the graph.
The number of possible attack paths over the number of edges.
The number of edges over the number of possible attack paths.
questions.explanation: Reachability is treated as a share of the graph's connectivity that the attacker can exploit.
questions.explanation_ar: الوصول يُعامل كحصة من اتصالية المخطّط يقدر المهاجم يستغلها.

questions.question: How does segmentation change that probability?
options: All paths are counted but with a larger denominator.
The paths are multiplied by the number of zones.
The edges are removed from the graph entirely.
Only paths crossing the controlled gateways are counted.
options_ar: تُحتسب كل المسارات لكن بمقام أكبر.
تُحتسب فقط المسارات اللي تعبر البوابات المتحكَّم بها.
options_en: All paths are counted but with a larger denominator.
The paths are multiplied by the number of zones.
The edges are removed from the graph entirely.
Only paths crossing the controlled gateways are counted.
questions.explanation: The cut-set is the set of controlled gateway edges, and communication between zones has to cross them.
questions.explanation_ar: مجموعة القطع هي حواف البوابات المتحكَّم بها، والاتصال بين المناطق لازم يعبرها.

questions.question: What happens to lateral movement as the controlled cut-set grows?
questions.question_ar: شنو يصير للحركة الجانبية كل ما كبرت مجموعة القطع المتحكَّم بها؟
options: Fewer paths remain available, so the probability falls.
More paths open up, so the probability rises.
The probability stays the same but latency improves.
The graph loses its edges and becomes disconnected.
options_ar: مسارات أقل تبقى متاحة، فتنزل الاحتمالية.
الاحتمالية تبقى نفسها بس زمن الاستجابة يتحسّن.
options_en: Fewer paths remain available, so the probability falls.
More paths open up, so the probability rises.
The probability stays the same but latency improves.
The graph loses its edges and becomes disconnected.
questions.explanation: Every additional controlled gateway removes routes the attacker could otherwise take, which is the whole point of the cut-set.
questions.explanation_ar: كل بوابة متحكَّم بها إضافية تزيل مسارات كان المهاجم يقدر يسلكها، وهذا هدف مجموعة القطع كله.

questions.question: What does segmentation primarily limit?
options: The number of certificates in the chain.
Lateral movement after an initial breach.
The initial infection of the first host.
The speed of the network backbone.
options_en: The number of certificates in the chain.
Lateral movement after an initial breach.
The initial infection of the first host.
The speed of the network backbone.
questions.explanation: It does not prevent the first compromise; it prevents that compromise from becoming a tour of the estate.
questions.explanation_ar: ما يمنع الاختراق الأول؛ يمنع إن ذلك الاختراق يصير جولة بكل المؤسسة.
